snippet.title: Helldivers 2 - Return of the Cyborgs Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Helldivers, we stand on the precipice of Cyberstan, and at last, our enemy stands revealed.

Study them closely. Steel yourselves for battle.

Let's end this Machinery of Oppression once and for all.
